result.title: STAR: Structure-Aware Temporal Action Recovery for Point Supervised Temporal Action Localization
result.summary: Point supervised temporal action localization is becoming the need of time in this era of ever growing and non-stop video data. Existing method mainly rely on snippet level action response to generate pseudo labels. However, these labels often suffer from boundary ambiguity, over extended proposals, and weak temporal structure. To address these issues, we propose STAR, a structure-aware Temporal Action Recovery framework for point supervised temporal action localization. STAR works by enhancing the base S model with temporal difference interaction with attention module to capture forward and backward snippet changes, and introduces the learning of start, core, and end roles to model the internal temporal structure of actions. In addition, STAR further improves the pseudo label generation through All point proposal ranking and Rolebank based structural re-ranking, which suppress neighbor crossing and structurally inconsistent proposals. Finally, temporal action detector to STAR feedback supervision transfers high quality detector prediction back to the STAR model through soft start, core, end, action, and background targets. This helps to further refine the pseudo labels. Extensive experiments on four standard benchmarks shows the effectiveness of STAR. By using I3D features, STAR achieves 67.2% at AVG@0.1:0.7 on THUMOS'14, 58.1% on GTEA, 74.6% on BEOID, and 31.7% at AVG@0.5:0.95 on ActivityNet-1.3, outperforming previous point supervised methods across multiple benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 STAR 框架，用于点监督时序动作定位：通过时序差分注意力建模动作的 start/core/end 内部结构，并用提案排序与角色重排改进伪标签，再把检测器预测回灌为软监督。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于纯视频时序动作定位的伪标签与边界精化工作，不涉及视觉语言模型或 latent 推理状态，也未提供关于视觉细节保留、latent 生成或停止决策的具体借鉴线索。
